# mcloud generate

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from the command's help in `internal/cli`._

[All commands](README.md)

Write deploy/k8s from the app's functions.

Write the manifests for the app's functions into deploy/k8s (--dir):
functions.yaml (rewritten every time) and the kustomization listing it.
Queue functions need the app's database: db: true in maxcloud.yaml.

The deploy workflow does the same on every push, from the image it built.
Run it locally to see what a deploy would change: it asks the built app
(npx maxcloud-functions --describe, in source: from maxcloud.yaml), so
build the app first. A Go app describes itself with go run . --describe;
pipe that in with --from -.

```
mcloud generate [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud generate
go run . --describe | mcloud generate --from -
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dir` string | `deploy/k8s` | manifests directory |
| `--from` string |  | read the description from this file, or - for stdin, instead of asking the app |
| `--image` string | `app` | image name in the manifests, which the deploy workflow replaces |
